title: PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL: Polarization-Keyed Examination Papers and Mandatory Issued Eyewear that Displace AI Glasses and Extend Universal Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.31299v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Camera-equipped AI glasses turn an examination page into a query for a remote vision-language model. Device detection targets possession, and our companion work SEOYUN targets the model. PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL instead changes who owns the eyewear. Every candidate wears authority-issued glasses for the whole session, and the question paper is printed so that it can be read only through them. As in cinema stereoscopy, a patterned laminate encodes the text in the handedness of circular polarization rather than in brightness. The page looks uniformly grey to the naked eye and to unfiltered cameras, and the issued circular analyzer reveals the text. Compulsory issued eyewear turns the smart-glasses form factor against itself. The face position is occupied by a device the authority supplies and collects, and a camera anywhere else needs its own analyzer. translated_title: PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL：偏振密钥试卷与强制配发眼镜——取代AI眼镜并扩展通用设计
translated_abstract: 配备摄像头的AI眼镜可将试卷页面变为对远程视觉-语言模型的查询。设备检测针对的是设备持有行为，而我们的配套工作SEOYUN针对的是模型本身。PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL则改变了眼镜的归属权：每位考生在整场考试中都佩戴考试机构配发的眼镜，且试卷以特殊方式印制，只能通过该眼镜阅读。如同电影立体放映技术，一种图案化层压材料将文本以圆偏振的旋向而非亮度进行编码。在肉眼和未经滤波的摄像头看来，页面呈现均匀的灰色，而配发的圆偏振检偏镜则能显现文本。强制性配发眼镜使智能眼镜的外形因素反过来对其自身形成制约：面部位置已被考试机构提供并回收的设备占据，任何其他位置的摄像头都需要自己的检偏器才能读取内容。戴眼镜的考生可在配发镜框内安装处方镜片插入件，低视力考生……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL协议，通过向全体考生强制配发官方眼镜、并以圆偏振编码印制试卷（肉眼和摄像头只能看到均匀灰色页面），从“眼镜归属权”层面根本性地阻断AI眼镜摄像头作弊，同时通过处方插入件兼容戴镜和低视力考生。
en_tdlr: PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL shifts exam anti-cheating from device detection to eyewear ownership by mandating authority-issued glasses and printing polarization-keyed papers that appear uniformly grey to naked eyes and cameras, displacing AI-glasses cheating while extending universal design to prescription-wearing and low-vision candidates.
